description: The report-group VARYING clause (§2023:13.18.64) — an independent temporary integer counter per repetition of a repeating report entry: first occurrence ← arithmetic-expression-1 (default 1, GR3a), subsequent occurrences += arithmetic-expression-2 (default 1, GR3b); each value persists through its occurrence (GR4 — usable as a SOURCE item). LIVE (P10 Step 13) on the multiple-COLUMN repetition vehicle (SR1); the OCCURS / multiple-LINE vehicles stage 0899 with the report-group OCCURS family. 2002 introduction — same derivation chain as report-present-when-2002 (VCR row 101's 2002→2014 TERMINATE-with-VARYING flagging delta presupposes the 2002 clause).
vcr: 2002 RW addition (VCR row 101 presupposes it in 2002; Annex E 2014→2023 has no introduction hit)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMRVY1.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT RPT ASSIGN TO "vmrvy1.rpt".
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD RPT REPORT IS R-1.
REPORT SECTION.
RD R-1.
01 D-1 TYPE DE.
   03 LINE PLUS 1.
      05 COLUMNS ARE 1 5 9 PIC Z9 SOURCE IS R-V VARYING R-V FROM 1 BY 2.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT RPT.
    INITIATE R-1.
    GENERATE D-1.
    TERMINATE R-1.
    CLOSE RPT.
    STOP RUN.
